note: The Season 1 layout: 7 chapters x 20 cases. 'old:cX-NN' = one of the original 48 cases (kept in tools/scam-lab/archive); 'new:key' = a case written in tools/scam-lab/specs/chN.mjs.

chapters.title: Fake Helpers
chapters.blurb: Fake banks, couriers, support and admins: the most reported scams.
chapters.learn: fake bank, courier, toll and refund messages, fake support and admins, and when a message is simply honest.

chapters.title: Too Good To Be True
chapters.blurb: Fake prizes, shops, rentals and buyers: when a deal looks perfect.
chapters.learn: fake prizes, shops, rentals, marketplace buyers and giveaways, and when an offer is simply honest.

chapters.title: Bad Apps, Links & Wallet Traps
chapters.blurb: Fake apps, QR codes, codes and wallet pop-ups: tricks that take over your phone.
chapters.learn: app files in chats, fake fines and KYC, QR stickers, remote-access support, wallet signatures and when an update is honest.

chapters.title: Fear & Panic
chapters.blurb: Fake police, customs, tax and bank calls: scams that make you panic.
chapters.learn: digital arrest and parcel calls, fake tax and legal threats, blackmail texts, panic messages, and when a notice is honest.

chapters.title: Job & Task Scams
chapters.blurb: Fake jobs, task apps, overseas agents and cheques: when a job asks you to pay.
chapters.learn: work-from-home and task scams, fee-for-a-job traps, interview and ID scams, overpayment cheques, money-moving jobs, and what an honest employer looks like.

chapters.title: Love & Long Cons
chapters.blurb: Romance, family-emergency and long-game scams built on trust.
chapters.learn: romance and wrong-number cons, family and boss impersonation, voice copies, recovery agents, fake charities, and what a real friend looks like.

chapters.title: Money Traps
chapters.blurb: Fake investments, tips, brokers and tokens: promises of fast, safe profit.
chapters.learn: stock-tip groups, fake brokers and platforms, guaranteed-profit promises, pump and rug-pull tokens, and what a plain honest investment looks like.
